title: StudyLabProceduralCardAnchor
description: Canonical schema for the StudyLab Procedural Card Anchor JSON embedded in Anki 'StudyLab Procedural Anchor' notes.

proc_schema.description: Schema ID of the target practice object (e.g. 'schema.math.number_system.lcm_hcf.v1').

content_ref.description: Optional ID referencing the originating pattern or question item.

custom_params.description: Optional map of fixed parameter values overriding random generation.

seed_mode.description: Strategy for problem instance generation seed.

inline_contract.description: Modern self-contained rich-content contract bundled directly in the anchor. When present, cards generate with zero pre-seeded database dependencies.
